title: A Cellar for the Hymn
author: Orsen Ashgrove
blurb: Mirabel Thackeray, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
